workflows.doa.conflict.value: Someone changed this version meanwhile. It has been reloaded.SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS

workflows.doa.empty.value: No versions yet. Start a draft.SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS

workflows.doa.failed.value: That did not work. Try again.SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS

workflows.doa.refused.wrongState.value: The version has moved on meanwhile.SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS

workflows.doa.sim.noRule.value: No rule applies to such a memo.SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS

workflows.failed.value: That did not work. Try again.SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS
